source_text: Non volentis neque currentis sed miserentis Dei. Cuius vult miseretur, et quem vult indurat. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Not of the one willing nor of the one running but of God who shows mercy. He has mercy on whom he wills, and whom he wills he hardens. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[It depends not on human will or exertion, but on God, who has mercy >> Bible:Romans 9:16]]. [[He has mercy on whomever he wills, and he hardens whomever he wills >> Bible:Romans 9:18]]. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
